calls.statement:
WITH active AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21'
),
ver AS (
    SELECT a.member_id, count(cur.member_key) AS n_versions, min(cur.tier) AS tier
    FROM active a
    LEFT JOIN dim_member cur ON cur.member_id = a.member_id AND DATE '2025-12-21' BETWEEN cur.valid_from AND cur.valid_to
    GROUP BY a.member_id
)
SELECT n_versions, tier, count(*) AS members FROM ver GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

calls.statement:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.member_key, m.member_id, f.receipt_id, f.channel_code, s.store_id, p.category, wo.status
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order wo ON wo.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900
  WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21'
)
SELECT
  count(*) AS lines,
  count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS distinct_line_ids,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE member_key IS NOT NULL AND member_id IS NULL) AS orphan_member_keys,
  count(DISTINCT member_id) AS all_members,
  count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT (store_id = 999 OR category = 'ZZ Test')) AS excl_test,
  count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE status IS DISTINCT FROM 'cancelled') AS excl_cancelled,
  count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT (store_id = 999 OR category = 'ZZ Test') AND status IS DISTINCT FROM 'cancelled') AS excl_both,
  count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE store_id = 999) AS in_999,
  count(DISTINCT member_id) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled') AS in_cancelled
FROM base

SELECT d.fiscal_week_end_date AS week_end, count(*) AS lines, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.member_key IS NOT NULL) AS member_lines, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) AS days
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT wo.login_state, (f.member_key IS NULL) AS line_member_null, (wo.member_key IS NULL) AS order_member_null, count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT wo.web_order_id) AS orders
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order wo ON wo.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

calls.statement:
WITH as_of AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, r.period_end_date AS as_of_end
    FROM dim_date d
    JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar r ON r.fiscal_year = d.fiscal_year AND r.fiscal_period = d.fiscal_period
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 8
),
active AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    CROSS JOIN as_of
    WHERE f.sale_date > as_of.as_of_end - 364
      AND f.sale_date <= as_of.as_of_end
)
SELECT as_of.fiscal_year, as_of.fiscal_period, cur.tier, COUNT(*) AS active_members
FROM active a
CROSS JOIN as_of
JOIN dim_member cur ON cur.member_id = a.member_id
                   AND as_of.as_of_end BETWEEN cur.valid_from AND cur.valid_to
GROUP BY as_of.fiscal_year, as_of.fiscal_period, cur.tier
ORDER BY CASE cur.tier WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 2 WHEN 'Gold' THEN 3 END
